summary: Implemented all 5 plan phases: a durable, gitignored, machine-local redeploy ledger (scripts/lib/deploy-ledger-lib.sh, default specs/.orchestrator-deploy-ledger.json) consulted by the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint before its first expensive call, with a content-hash skip (ordinary case) and an attributed-recency skip (self-modifying-task class, where the hash changes on every cycle by construction). deploy_pending override and deploy_failed/blocking negative records preserve the completion-deploy gate's backstop. Added 27 new deploy-ledger-lib unit tests and 7 new Group 11 end-to-end cases (l-r), including the NAMED self-modifying-task acceptance criterion (total deploy count stays 1 across 3 invocations; a hash-only counterfactual redeploys 3/3 times). Registered the ledger as an 18th gitignored runtime-file class member and rewrote the guardrails contract documentation (Idempotence guard scope correction, new Durable redeploy ledger paragraph, D6 residual clause fix, not resolved).
